result.title: RDCompGS: Rate-Distortion Optimization for Compression of 3D Gaussian Splatting with Image Codecs
result.comment: This manuscript has been submitted to IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (TMM)
result.summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-quality, real-time novel view synthesis but requires significant storage and transmission resources. Mapping Gaussian attributes to 2D representations enables efficient compression using mature image codecs. However, Gaussian representations that achieve comparable rendering quality are generally treated similarly during optimization, despite substantial differences in coding rate, leading to limited rate-distortion (R-D) performance after compression. To address this limitation, we propose RDCompGS, a 3DGS compression method that enables overall R-D optimization of Gaussian representations with respect to subsequent coding. A differentiable estimate of the coding rate is incorporated into the R-D optimization with rendering distortion. The rate constraint adjustment model further regulates the R-D trade-off across different compression conditions. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that RDCompGS achieves average Bjøntegaard Delta Rate reductions of 37.84% and 49.31% with H.265/HEVC and JPEG XL, respectively. The estimated rate also shows a strong correlation with the actual bit-rate under different compression conditions.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 RDCompGS，将可微的编码码率估计与渲染失真联合起来，对 3D Gaussian Splatting 的表示做率失真优化，并配以码率约束调整模型，在 H.265/HEVC 与 JPEG XL 下取得显著 BD-Rate 降低。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究主题是 3DGS 存储与传输压缩，属渲染表示编码问题，未涉及视觉推理状态生成、证据筛选、动态计算或停止决策等 LVR 关注点，也无可核查的方法借鉴线索。
